1. That you, Demo Traders, issued to my client Suresh Gupta a cheque dated 1 September 2026 for Rs 3,00,000 drawn on HDFC Bank, Karol Bagh.

2. That my client presented the said cheque on 15 September 2026, and the return memo is dated 18 September 2026.

3. That the amount of Rs 3,00,000 remains unpaid.

4. That my client therefore calls upon you to pay the said amount within fifteen days of receipt of this notice.
